title: ThreatMapLiteIOCAnnotationDataset
description: Schema for ThreatMap Lite IOC Ground-Truth Evaluation Datasets

report_id.description: Unique identifier for the threat intelligence report (e.g., Mandiant-APT29-2023).

synthetic.description: True if the report is a synthetic fixture; False if based on a real threat document.

source_file.description: Original PDF filename or reference document URL.

pages.description: List of extracted pages from the report.

page_text.description: Full extracted plain text of the page.

ground_truth.description: List of human-verified IOC ground-truth annotations.

type.description: Category of the Indicator of Compromise.

value.description: Normalized indicator string (e.g., lowercase hash, standard IP).

page_number.description: Page on which this indicator first appears or is referenced.

notes.description: Human analyst notes regarding attribution, C2 role, or context.
